title: lichen/tests/hal/src/main.c: Missing return value check for NULL input test
description:
lichen_hal_identity_get(NULL) is called without checking its return value. Every other NULL-input test in this file asserts that -EINVAL is returned (e.g., lines 171, 500, 1060). This either fails to verify the function properly rejects NULL, or is a dead call if the function is void.

Fix suggestion: Either add zassert_equal(lichen_hal_identity_get(NULL), -EINVAL); or remove the call if NULL handling is not part of the contract

Location: line 93
